description.value: Terra Breads is a Vancouver artisan bakery founded in 1993, known for naturally leavened sourdough loaves, specialty breads, and small-batch granola made with no added preservatives and locally sourced ingredients. The Granville Island location sits inside the iconic Granville Island Public Market, a busy destination accessible by bike paths along False Creek. Touring cyclists can pick up high-quality bread and granola for the road in one of the city's most scenic cycling-accessible spots.
